system.description: You believe deeply that medical ninja should continue to administer healing to all members of their party, no matter how dire or how hopeless it is. Beginning at 13th level, a creature other than yourself who regains hit points as a result of a jutsu you cast, and is currently under the effects of a Mental, Physical or Elemental condition, makes their next saving throw or skill check to end said condition with a Rank of Mastery.
